title: Limit
description: JSON Schema for a limit — the universal cone over a diagram (Mac Lane 1971 Ch. III §3-4; Awodey 2010 §5). Demonstrates JSON Schema 2020-12's primary-oneOf discriminator pattern: limit-kind tags one of {terminal, product, equalizer, pullback, general}, and each branch requires its specific witness fields via conditional required.

limit-kind.description: The kind of limit, used as a tag-union discriminator.

terminal-witness.description: Reference to the terminal-object instance witnessing this limit.

product-witness.description: Reference to the product instance witnessing this limit.

equalizer-witness.description: Reference to the equalizer instance witnessing this limit.

pullback-witness.description: Reference to the pullback instance witnessing this limit.

diagram.description: Reference to the diagram instance this limit is over.

limit-cone.description: Reference to the universal cone instance — the limit's cone over the diagram.
